title: アルゼンチン共和国杯にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan's friends are all gathered in the stands at the Copa Republica Argentina.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's Mejiro Palmer, Daitaku Helios, and the group of students who she's become friends with recently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Jordan gets a message from her friends showing their support, and then heads out to the race.
